<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **21** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/view.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**11** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS))_
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-form.mdx`  _(via ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS), drawerSide (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm; a string literal in apply; a string literal in dataProps; a string literal in interactions), drawerWidth (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm; a string literal in apply; a string literal in dataProps; a string literal in interactions), modalSize (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`  _(via ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const), ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS), tabPosition (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx`  _(via ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS), REACT_BLOCKS (symbol, a top-level const object), drawerSide (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm; a string literal in apply; a string literal in dataProps; a string literal in interactions))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via drawerWidth (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm; a string literal in apply; a string literal in dataProps; a string literal in interactions))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via retiredAfter (symbol, a field of const object formViewDrawerKeysRemoved), retiredFromLoadPath (symbol, a field of const object formViewDrawerKeysRemoved))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/index.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/view.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 504ba5108effc72f5b798070e73c8b0a699c63b1` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `84b9f533d051118b740bd20e4be9bacb7aacefea` — the merge of head `ffc3fe89618b871f7bd587b607da9e42cad6244f` into base `504ba5108effc72f5b798070e73c8b0a699c63b1`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 84b9f533d051118b740bd20e4be9bacb7aacefea && git checkout 84b9f533d051118b740bd20e4be9bacb7aacefea
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 504ba5108effc72f5b798070e73c8b0a699c63b1 ffc3fe89618b871f7bd587b607da9e42cad6244f && git checkout -B drift-repro 504ba5108effc72f5b798070e73c8b0a699c63b1 && git merge --no-ff ffc3fe89618b871f7bd587b607da9e42cad6244f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 504ba5108effc72f5b798070e73c8b0a699c63b1
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 504ba5108effc72f5b798070e73c8b0a699c63b1` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单视图上的 `drawerSide`、`drawerWidth` 两个键退役：写了会被拒，并提示删除;已存的旧视图读出时自动去掉。React 的 `ObjectForm` 块照常保留这两个属性，作为块自己的参数。
- 为什么改：这两个键能存、能发布，但没有任何表单视图界面读它们，写了等于没写(#29012,ADR-0049「要么生效，要么移除」)。
- 风险与回滚：收窄(BREAKING),仓内没有作者写过这两个键;同版本待发的 #27155 changeset 里「这两个键保留」一句已同步改正。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` 的两个 tombstone,`packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts` 的 overlay。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/form-view-drawer-keys-retirement.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：可落地，等契约复审。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:spec#1` · head `8a8c90a7`

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main` (includes #29083, `104cd1a58d`), `Fixes #29012`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` / `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` at line start in the body and the changeset (BREAKING minor, migration, one ADR-0087 marker). Within claim 6573656255's surface. **Governed:** the diff touches `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`, and the CI Governed Surface Queue Guard on this head LIFTED it as a byte-equal regeneration of `gen:react-blocks` (#11705 register), CLEAR. So it is not Tier H.
2. **Diff, read on the head:** `FormViewSchema.drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` become `retiredKey()` tombstones. The React `ObjectForm` block keeps both as its own overlay props, and `REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS.ObjectForm` ledgers the name collision. ADR-0087 kit: D2 conversion `form-view-drawer-keys-removed` (`retiredFromLoadPath`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`), D3 `ui-form-view-drawer-keys-retired`, two retired-key entries, and the step-18 template fragment. Liveness view 75/8 → 73/10. Authorable surface and references regenerated.
3. **Seat ruling, applied at `8a8c90a7`:** the pending `.changeset/27155-form-view-type-layout-only.md` "Unchanged" bullet no longer says `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` stay, and it names their retirement in the same release. This is the deliberate-correction class, so `check-empty-changeset` exits 1 and the 'Check Changeset' red on this head is by design. The check is not required; nothing was restored and no skip-changeset was added.
4. **Forced test edit (1, named):** in `form-view-presentation-types-removed`, the quick bystander `drawerSide` became `title`.
5. **Readings (dev, at `8c7bfc30`; `8a8c90a7` differs by that one changeset sentence):** 112/112 derived gates, DERIVED zero; dogfood 388 passed + 3 skipped; spec 789 files; test:repo 88/88; lint 189/189; ui plugin-form 217/217; adr-0087, no-major `--event` and empty-changeset self-test exit 0. ui type-check was not measured locally; CI Type Check UI is the reading. Check-runs on `8a8c90a7` at this reading: 52 success, 8 skipped, 1 failure (Check Changeset, by design), 3 still running.
6. **PR body:** stale on the head (names `8c7bfc30`, not the 27155 correction). The dev declined to patch it per os-dev.md L63. This record is the current-head reading. The process gap is #29145.
7. **Landing:** one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review (a narrowing), which the seat runs itself (claim line follows). Then the seat readies and queues. After it lands, #29037 (same file) is next.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8a8c90a767b0b890e7752864a1aabf6f46b1c2af`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__FormView__drawerSide.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__FormView__drawerWidth.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-form-view-drawer-keys-retired.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template, packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md + ui/packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectFormContainer.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts (ObjectFormPropsSchema), packages/spec/src/conversions/walk.ts (mapViewPayloads), packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.test.ts (overlay-shadow ledger), packages/spec/scripts/build-react-blocks-contract.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-react-page-props.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/README.md, .claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md, docs/adr/0049-no-unenforced-security-properties.md, docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md (2026-10-26 addendum), .changeset/27155-form-view-type-layout-only.md, .changeset/27159-*.md, .changeset/29012-form-view-drawer-keys-retired.md, packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs (packagesTouched), scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs (via the Check Changeset log). Narrowing-face floor: every non-prose path of the diff was read, the four edited pins and the new pin `packages/spec/src/ui/form-view-drawer-keys-retirement.test.ts` included.

### ① Derived judgments

- `FormViewSchema.drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` become `retiredKey()` tombstones: the accept set of every form-view door narrows (the schema, `view.form`, `view.formViews.*`, a ViewItem form record's `config`, the flattened form overlay, `defineStack` as `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422), and the `FormView` input type refuses both at a TypeScript authoring site. **Right** — the triage ruling (6571544001) is retire under ADR-0049; `type: 'drawer'` left the enum in #27155, so no form view can reach `DrawerForm`, and the only path that hands the keys to `DrawerForm.tsx` (L313 side, L718-724 width) is `ObjectFormContainer.tsx` L149-179 behind the `object-form` block's `formType === 'drawer'`.
- React `ObjectForm` block contract: the two names leave `dataProps` (which are read off `FormViewSchema.shape` by `build-react-blocks-contract.ts dataProps(schema, allow)`) and are redeclared as `binding` interactions with the same types (`'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'`, `string`) and descriptions; `REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS.ObjectForm = ['drawerSide', 'drawerWidth']` ledgers the name collision with the tombstones. **Right** — the shape test in `react-blocks.test.ts` holds the ledger equal to the computed collision set in both directions, so the row is required, and the meaning is preserved (same type, same prose). Consequence: `validate-react-page-props` builds `knownProps` from interactions only (L174), so the two props are now known there and a near-miss on a React page is reported; before, as data props, they were outside its known set. A gain, not a loss.
- `ObjectFormPropsSchema` (`component.zod.ts` L7076-7077) keeps `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth`; `ui/packages/types` `ObjectFormSchema` declares its own (`objectql.zod.ts` L1035-1036, `objectql.ts` L2243-2249); the block's registered inputs (`plugin-form/src/index.tsx` L343-344) are the block's own. **Right** — no `ui/` type derives the two from `FormView`, which is why `Type Check UI` stays green with no `ui/` edit (AGENTS.md checklist 4 measured, not assumed).
- D2 `form-view-drawer-keys-removed` (`toMajor: 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, inserted in identifier order at `order: 81`, one more than the highest) strips both keys from every form payload `mapViewPayloads` reaches (ViewItem `config`, container `form` / `formViews.*`, flattened overlay) and the assembled `viewItems` channel; it never walks page components. **Right** — parallel to `form-view-buttons-reset-removed`, idempotent by `stripKeys`' construction, `expectedNotices: 5` = 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 as the fixture authors it, and `18.2.0` is the latest stable (`@objectstack/spec@18.2.0` per the Check Changeset log).
- `form-view-presentation-types-removed` fixture: the `quick` bystander `drawerSide: 'left'` → `title: 'Quick'`. **Right** — whole-table replay demands disjoint fixtures (skill §3) and `title` is a live `FormViewSchema` key; the docblock's "stays" sentence is corrected to point at the later entry.
- `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` +`ui/FormView:drawerSide`, +`ui/FormView:drawerWidth` (file names per `entries/README.md`, values spelled as `authorable-surface/ui.json` spells them); `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR[18].semantic` +`ui-form-view-drawer-keys-retired`; `STEP18_RATIONALE` +fragment at `order: 116` (one more than 115) in id-sorted position. **Right**.
- Generated artifacts: `authorable-surface/ui.json` two rows → `[RETIRED]`; `liveness/view.json` both rows `live → dead` with the house-style tombstone note; `state-counts/view.md` 75/8 → 73/10; `content/docs/references/**` and `react-blocks.md` regenerated; `api-surface/` unchanged. **Right** — a key-level tombstone on a def that still exists is invisible to the api-surface ratchet by design (skill §2), so zero change there is the expected reading.
- `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: the `omit` row for `view.drawerWidth` is dropped. **Right** — a tombstone is not a deliberately-unoffered live key.
- `.changeset/27155-form-view-type-layout-only.md` Unchanged bullet rewritten. **Wrong as written** — see ② and ④.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/29012-form-view-drawer-keys-retired.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': minor`, BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on both carriers (body and changeset), one `adr-0087: registered form-view-drawer-keys-removed, ui-form-view-drawer-keys-retired` marker, FROM → TO, the one-line fix, and a "What the parse says" quotation that matches the tombstone text byte-for-byte on its first sentence. The level follows the kind: a narrowed protocol on the one package whose `src/**` moves takes `minor` during the launch window. Correct. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the right line: nothing widens — two keys leave the form view, the block's props are redeclared with identical types.
- Check-runs on `8a8c90a7`: the ten required contexts (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint UI` (skipped, path-filtered), `Type Check UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`) are `success`; `Spec property liveness`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards` `success`. `Check Changeset` is `failure` on `check-empty-changeset` for `.changeset/27155-form-view-type-layout-only.md` — the documented DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, taken by the head commit `8a8c90a7`. The class is the right one; the correction's content is not (must-fix 1).
- **Must-fix 1 — the deliberate correction writes a false release-note sentence.** The rewritten bullet says "`splitDirection` and `modalSize` stay declared: … the React `ObjectForm` block contract still takes `splitDirection` from this schema until its renderer follows." On this tree `FormViewSchema.splitDirection` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone (`view.zod.ts` L5150, since #27159), `react-blocks.ts` dropped it from `dataProps` ("[#27159] `splitDirection` left with the split form renderer"), and the pending #27159 changeset says in its own text that `splitDirection` leaves in this release. The dev's `open_questions` entry states the bullet is false for all three keys; the commit fixes two and re-asserts the third in fresh words. A deliberate correction is tolerated only because it makes the pending note true; this one leaves `changeset version` to compile two contradicting sentences about `splitDirection` into the same `CHANGELOG.md`, the text an agent hitting the `splitDirection` tombstone greps. Fix, either way: (a) finish the correction — "`modalSize` stays declared: the console reads it for its record dialog. `splitDirection` (#27159) and `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` (#29012) retire from the form view in the same release; the React `ObjectForm` block keeps the drawer pair as its own props." — or (b) restore the file byte-exact from `main` and let the 29012 changeset supersede the line the way #27159's does (one sentence under Unchanged), which also greens Check Changeset. Whichever is taken, say so in the PR body: its Acceptance note still says the bullet was left as it is.
- **Should-fix 2 — `@objectstack/skills` moves without a changeset line.** `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` is published content of `@objectstack/skills` (`packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copies `skills/**` into `dist/skills/` at build); the #27159 changeset, which regenerated the same contract, carried `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. `check-changeset-no-major`'s `packagesTouched` reads only `src/**`, a packed `bin`, and the console build's copy (`PACKED_COPY_BUILD_SCRIPTS`), so no gate names the omission. Add `'@objectstack/skills': patch` to the 29012 changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation "react-blocks.ts and react-blocks.md edited beyond the claim's file surface": accepted — `dataProps` reads `FormViewSchema`, so the tombstone forces the overlay move, and the skill's retirement surfaces include the published skills row; a consequence of the tombstone, not scope growth. Right.
- Dev deviation "forced edit to `form-view-presentation-types-removed`'s fixture": accepted — fixture disjointness (skill §3). Right.
- Dev deviation "PR opened at `0dc8fcc3`, changeset pushed a minute later; tests at `0dc8fcc3` differ from `8c7bfc30` by the changeset only": accepted; the head is now `8a8c90a7`, which differs from `8c7bfc30` by one changeset line, and CI on `8a8c90a7` is the reading. Right.
- Dev deviation "no MCP assignee/reviewer write": right (order forbids it).
- Dev deviation "first conversion ablation threw; rerun as pass-through": a report of method, no tree consequence. Fine.
- `open_questions[0]` (the 27155 Unchanged bullet; dev recommended A = leave it): the tree took B (the dev's own commit `8a8c90a7`, deliberate correction) — answered against the recommendation, and the B taken is incomplete. Escalated as must-fix 1 above; the seat picks (a) or (b).
- `out_of_scope_findings`: `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts` L1772 docblock still lists `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` among the `[spec-aligned]` FormView keys — comment drift under `ui/`, outside the card's surface; **should-fix 3** as a one-line follow-up in the next `ui/` PR that touches the file, not a blocker here. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` re-score: the QA lane's, correctly not filed.
- Claim conditions: `ui/packages/plugin-form/**` only if `Type Check UI` reds — it is green, no `ui/` edit, honoured. `hideFields` lines (#29083) and personal scope/sharing keys (#29037) not touched by this diff — honoured. Serial constraint "merge main after #29083 lands": #29083 merged at `104cd1a5`, which is an ancestor of `8a8c90a7` — honoured (and it is the tree the dev's readings name). Card `premise_still_valid: true` — the describe deferring to closed #27153 is gone from the tree.
- **Should-fix 4 — PR body stale against the tree.** The body's "Acceptance notes" say the 27155 bullet is left as is "so Check Changeset stays green"; the head commit edits it and Check Changeset is red by design. The body also lists `8c7bfc30` as the head under Tests. Refresh the body to the tree's choice (the deliberate-correction sentence the gate's own remedy text asks for).

### ④ Design judgment

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` — holds. Both prescriptions follow the five guidance conventions: fully-qualified key in backticks, `was removed in @objectstack/spec 18.3.0 (ADR-0049)`, a dash clause stating why it was inert, an imperative fix naming the live mechanism (`navigation.mode` for a list's record drawer, `navigation.size` for its width, the `ObjectForm` block's own props for a React page), and the standard migrate sentence via `FORM_VIEW_TYPE_RETIRED_FIX` with `--from 17` (toMajor 18 − 1). Judged against the card's repro: `PUT /meta/view … config: { drawerSide: 'left', drawerWidth: '480px' }` now meets the ViewItem form-record door and is refused with the prescription (pinned at that door); a row already stored is stripped on read by `applyConversionsToStoredItem` (pinned with `includeRetired` semantics).
